# Aurum Bites Full Context

> Reliable sourcing and distribution of high-quality dairy products for businesses and consumers.

## Site Structure & Pages

- [Home](https://www.aurumbites.co.in/): The main landing page.
- [About Us](https://www.aurumbites.co.in/about): Learn more about Aurum Bites.
- [Contact / Enquire](https://www.aurumbites.co.in/contact): Contact information and business hours for customer inquiries.
- [Login](https://www.aurumbites.co.in/login): Access your user account.
- [Register](https://www.aurumbites.co.in/register): Create a new user account.
- [Quick Shipping](https://www.aurumbites.co.in/quick-shipping): Details on fast delivery options.

## Collections & Filters

- **Categories**: [Butter](https://www.aurumbites.co.in/category/butter), [Cheese Slice](https://www.aurumbites.co.in/category/cheese--slice), [Cream](https://www.aurumbites.co.in/category/cream), [Fresh Cheese](https://www.aurumbites.co.in/category/fresh-cheese), [Fries](https://www.aurumbites.co.in/category/fries), [Oil](https://www.aurumbites.co.in/category/oil), [Imported Cheese](https://www.aurumbites.co.in/category/imported-cheese).
- **Brands**: Amul, Crème Italia, Dairy Craft, Modern Dairy, Pasta Zara, McCain, Prestige, Jacks Cheese, Gran Mantovano, Vega Gourmet, Fortune, Chevre, Fiorella, Arla, Hungritos, Kanaki, Rich's, Ybarra. (Accessible via `https://www.aurumbites.co.in/brand/{slug}`)
- **Cities**: Delhi, Delhi NCR, West Delhi, North Delhi. (Accessible via `https://www.aurumbites.co.in/city/{slug}`)
